posts.headline: Seventeen straight editions of dead air from One Nut Barner, and now Put it in Ra actually DROPPED Week 1 at 0-1 — the league-best 1.5 average finish and 20-8 record finally has a crack in it.
posts.detail: Adam has said nothing for over two weeks while his historic 20-8, 1.5-avg-finish résumé sat unbothered, but a 123.66-point loss to open the season is the first real dent in the pedigree — silence won't cover this one.

posts.headline: Told you the reckoning was coming — Sasinci opened 0-1 at 101.6 points, the second-lowest score in the league, and Big Head's 13-15 career record just got heavier.
posts.detail: A title banner means nothing when you can't crack 102 points in Week 1; Megamind's threats to quit the league might start sounding tempting to him after this one.

posts.headline: talentedtenthh actually won Week 1 — 120.4 points and a 1-0 start is the first crack of daylight in the worst résumé in Busters Anonymous history.
posts.detail: After a 4-10 season and a dead-last 12th-place finish, one win doesn't erase the untalented tenth label, but it's the first data point in two years that isn't an outright disaster.

posts.headline: Thicks opened 1-0, but 138.94 points is the lowest winning score in the league and hardly the statement a reigning-adjacent title team should be making.
posts.detail: A 14-14 career record and 5.5 average finish already made the #FreeMaxx crown look shakier than the hype suggested, and squeaking out a win with the league's softest winning total doesn't quiet the doubters.

author.name: Easy way or the Hard Way

posts.headline: Easy Way or the Hard Way opened 0-1 at a league-worst 81.86 points, and Auntie Thomas is picking up right where last year's dead-last 10th-place finish left off.
posts.detail: A 6-8 rookie campaign was bad enough, but scoring under 82 in Week 1 suggests this year's basement race already has its frontrunner.
